LeBrunSalamon.PublishedInputs.Smoothness.actual_native_conclusion: For every b:Spec(K[ε]/ε²)→Y over K centred at x≫f, hT supplies a:Spec(K[ε]/ε²)→X over K centred at x and satisfying a≫f=b. The conclusion is an actual open U⊆X containing range(x) with Smooth(U.ι≫f). All three lift equations and the open restriction retain the literal maps.

EGAIV4 17.11.1(d)⇒(a), printed82–83, applies: the smooth structural maps supply local finite presentation, and the K-rational source/image points have the required identical residue field. Smoothness near that point gives the displayed open.
